slice: Slice 4A2 — Board technical-state distribution migration: concentration + dispersion
objective: Migrate the two remaining Board current-state distribution capabilities (pyramid_v2.concentration, pyramid_v2.dispersion) into Review by consuming the SAME exact-T Board-ready member facts already migrated in 4A1/4A1R/4A1R2. NO Board capability is deleted; only migrated. Pure capability migration — no Freshness, no Diffusion, no Relative Strength, no formula/lookback/threshold changes, no Board runtime removal.
supersedes: Slice 4A1 / 4A1R / 4A1R2 (all CLOSED at 11cd2c9e). Those migrated 9 Board current-state capabilities + core lineage lock + eligible universe. This slice adds the 10th/11th (technical_state.concentration / dispersion) reusing the identical Board-ready universe and exact-T source facts.
capabilities_targeted: pyramid_v2.concentration (Top3/Top5 contribution, HHI, leader_median_gap, leader_symbol, leader_magnitude, median_magnitude, count)
pyramid_v2.dispersion (count, mean, std, cv, p25, p50, p75, iqr, min, max, range)
source: exact-T source_core_run Board-ready member facts (same universe as 4A1R2: PIT membership ∩ Instrument.status=='active' ∩ exact-T StockFeatureSnapshot.first_pyramid_flat ∩ FirstPyramidSemanticAdapter.trend is not None). The technical magnitude change_magnitude is computed from each member's already-loaded exact-T fp_trend_strength / fp_dsa_vwap_dev_pct — NO second First Pyramid recompute, NO bar reload.
magnitude_formula: change_magnitude = abs(fp_trend_strength) if fp_trend_strength is not None else abs(fp_dsa_vwap_dev_pct) if fp_dsa_vwap_dev_pct is not None else 0.0. STRICT priority: |trend_strength| wins even when |dsa_vwap_dev_pct| is far larger (e.g. 0.1 vs 9.0 -> 0.1). NOT max(|trend_strength|, |vwap|).
concentration_formula: mags = board-ready technical magnitudes; sort DESC. total = sum(mags). top3 numerator = sum(top 3), top5 numerator = sum(top 5), denominator = total, all round(...,6). HHI = sum((m/total)^2) round 6 if total>0 else 0.0. leader = FIRST member (encounter order) with max(change_magnitude) — Board max() first-encountered tie semantics, NO (magnitude, symbol) re-tiebreak. median_magnitude = linear-interpolation percentile p50 (Review _percentile, which requires a sorted sequence, mirrors Board np.percentile linear interpolation). leader_median_gap = round(leader_magnitude - (median or 0.0), 6).
dispersion_formula: population (NOT sample): mean = sum/n; variance = sum((m-mean)^2)/n (divided by n, not n-1); std = sqrt(variance); cv = std/mean if mean!=0 else None. p25/p50/p75/iqr/min/max/range via linear-interpolation percentile, all round(...,6). Single member: std=0.0, cv=0.0 (NOT Review _stdev n<2 -> None, which is a different Review fact).
empty_and_zero_semantics: No board-ready member: concentration all-zero/Nones (top3/5 numerator/denominator 0.0, hhi 0.0, leader*/median None, count 0); dispersion all None (count 0, mean/std/cv/p25/p50/p75/iqr/min/max/range None). Universe non-empty but all magnitudes 0: concentration.count>0, hhi 0.0, leader_magnitude 0.0, median_magnitude 0.0, gap 0.0; dispersion mean 0.0, std 0.0, cv None. The two cases are kept distinct (not conflated).
placement: structure.current_state.technical_state.{concentration,dispersion}. Deliberately NEW key names under technical_state — these are NOT the existing Review price concentration / amount concentration facts (different semantics, different formulas).
instrument_meta_contract: _load_batch_instrument_active_status (4A1R2) is converged into _load_batch_instrument_board_meta: one SELECT of Instrument.id, Instrument.status, Instrument.symbol returns {str(id): {'eligible': status=='active', 'symbol': symbol}}. board_current_eligible AND board_current_symbol are both injected from this single result. No separate symbol query. Verified via rg that _load_batch_instrument_active_status had no unexpected production caller before rename.
leader_symbol_contract: MemberObservation.board_current_symbol carries Instrument.symbol (NOT the instrument UUID member_id). Injected from the same _load_batch_instrument_board_meta result as board_current_eligible.
parity_method: Same synthetic exact-T first_pyramid_flat member fixtures run through OLD Board producer private pure functions (_change_magnitude, _compute_concentration, _compute_dispersion) as oracle AND NEW Review _compute_board_technical_state. Hard gate: Review technical_state.concentration == OLD Board concentration AND == OLD Board dispersion, field-by-field after both round(...,6). Board functions imported only by tests, never by production Review code (AST gate PASS).

boundary_cases: normal multi-member: concentration/dispersion field-by-field equal to Board oracle
both magnitude inputs None -> 0.0 (not None), contributes zero weight
two members equal max magnitude -> leader = FIRST encountered (no symbol re-tiebreak)
single member -> std 0.0, cv 0.0 (population, not Review _stdev None)
all-zero magnitude but non-empty universe -> count>0, hhi 0.0, cv None (distinct from empty)
empty board-ready universe -> all None / zero (distinct from all-zero)
inactive + non-ready members fully excluded from universe
JSON round-trip (observation_payload -> JSONB -> observation_payload) preserves every field exactly
